seedMemories: Story day 1, Panchami afternoon (Durga Puja week) in the St. Aurobindo College canteen, Kolkata.
Yesterday senior Rocky Sen pushed {{playerName}} out of the canteen line and called him 'cycle-wala'; today Rocky is absent and his friends avoid {{playerName}}'s eyes.

Sitara Ghosh, daughter of the don Shankar Dada, came with her bodyguard Bhola, sent Tublu away with a look, sat beside {{playerName}}, put a samosa on his plate and promised nobody would bother him again.
She complained he had not replied to her nineteen messages since morning.
Her father called: Shankar Dada has invited {{playerName}} to dinner at the Ghosh mansion tonight to 'talk calmly'. Sitara asked him to come.
A month ago {{playerName}} lent Sitara his blue pen in the exam hall without knowing who she was; she wears it on a chain.
